svg.title: A foliated 1+1 causal triangulation
svg.desc: Seven uneven spatial loops form a cylinder. The arrow points up in time. Each blue triangle has its base on the earlier loop and each red triangle on the later loop.
svg.metadata: Original project illustration. SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause. Mesh polygons record three slice:vertex indices. OpenAI ImageGen supplied a visual reference. The editable polygons define a constructed triangulation with open time boundaries.
